To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the SiO2 Nps-gentamicin hybrid nanomaterials were successfully prepared and characterized.
the gentamicin-conjugate silica nanoparticles are promising for antimicrobial administration in bone applications.

the base-catalysed precipitation of gentamicin on the SiO2 nanoparticles is a promising method for the preparation of nanohybrids that are suitable for the administration of gentamicin in orthopedic surgical applications.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a nanosized delivery system for gentamicin.
the preparation of gentamicin-conjugate SiO2 NPS for the potential antimicrobial administration for orthopedic applications.
the preparation, characterization and antimicrobial action of SiO2 nanohybrids conjugated with the antibiotic gentamicin.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
SiO2-gemtamicin nanohybrid is a promising candidate for antimicrobial applications.
the SiO2 NPS can be used as a carrier for the prolonged release of gentamicin in orthopedic bone applications.
SiO2-genticamin nanohybrids are a promising antimicrobial agent for orthopedic applications.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
gentamicin-conjugation to the surface of SiO2 NPS can be an alternative to the systemic administration of gentamicin.
the SiO2 NPS can be used for the preparation of gentamicin-conjugates for their potential antimicrobical administration in orthopedics.
SiO2-gemtamicin nanohbrids are promising for antimicrobial applications in orthopedics.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the SiO2 nanohybrids can be used as a promising drug delivery system for the prolonged administration of gentamicin in orthopedic surgery.

the gentamicin release from the SiO2 Np hybrids is fast enough to provide high initial concentrations of antibiotics after surgical interventions and the extended gentamicin release justifies the potential antimicrobial administration of SiO2 Nps hybrids in bone applications.
the antimicrobial activity of SiO2 NPS is enhanced when conjugated with gentamicin.
